stable.notes: Fix Jobs.cz microsite email autofill by adding semantic email-field detection using labels, placeholders, aria metadata and nearby field text. Diagnostics now include the email field source. Manual queue behavior and manual final Submit safety remain unchanged.

beta.notes: Job Agent v2.9.12 beta improves useful follow-ups after zero automatic APPLY candidates. Based on v2.9.11 Mac run: 172 discovered, 108 enriched, 104 deduplicated/scored, 36 shortlisted; 12 REVIEW and zero APPLY after 40 previously processed applications. This is expected strict scoring, not a search failure. If no APPLY exists, Job Agent reports how many REVIEW candidates remain and up to three high-scoring, evidence-verified, Prague/remote-safe, supported Jobs.cz/Prace.cz human-review suggestions with skill-fit blockers and original job URLs. Users can explicitly select them in Dashboard and press Prepare now, which re-checks all safety gates. REVIEW is never promoted automatically, no application form opens just to show suggestions, and final Submit remains manual. Replaces misleading red 'No vacancy qualifies' message with clear 'No new vacancy qualifies for automatic APPLY'. GitHub Actions offline suite: 69/69 tests passed, including end-to-end no-automatic-form-opening regression.
